title: ITVX / Dramatic typographic emphasis
slide_intent: Give a single word dramatic weight while retaining service and programme attribution, because letterforms shape the tone and reading emphasis of a message.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen a recognizable voice across different programme moods.
demonstration: The word EVIL appears in very large white italic serif letters over a dark Des scene. ITVX sits at top left and DES at top right.
practical_value: Give a single word dramatic weight while retaining service and programme attribution.
